basic_info.name: mobilitypy
basic_info.description: mobilitypy 是面向半导体载流子输运的迁移率计算包，提供体材料与二维电子气中的离化杂质、合金无序、界面粗糙、声学和极性光学声子等散射机制模型，并可组合材料参数、温度和载流子浓度来分析总迁移率及主导散射机制。模型适用范围和材料参数仍需针对具体器件校核。

environment.description: 在 HEMT 或二维电子气材料参数、温度和载流子浓度给定时，分别评估离化杂质、合金无序、界面粗糙及声子等散射机制对总迁移率的限制。
environment.package_relation: 互补（C/D）：材料参数可由上游提供，结果可传给器件模型
environment.possible_task: 扫描温度和二维载流子浓度，分别计算各散射机制与总迁移率，找出不同区间的主导机制；断言 Matthiessen 组合关系成立、迁移率为正且机制切换点可由结果复算。

domain.level1: 半导体 02 器件与物理仿真

init_ref_tools.description: The functions in this class calculates the parameters for alloy from their binary components.

function.name: get_alloy_params
function.description: This function calculates the parameters for a ternary alloy from its binary component parameters using quadratic interpolation. E.g. for any parameter, P: P_SixGe1-x = x*P_Si + (1-x)*P_Ge - x*(1-x)*P_bowing P_bowing is the quadratic bowing parameter for the parameter P.

system.description: Type of the alloy. E.g. 'ternary'. The default is 'ternary'.

compositions.description: The alloy mole fractions. E.g. x values in Si_xGe_1-x. The default is None. If None, a composition array is generated using `np.linspace(start=0.01, end=0.99, num=101)`.

binaries.description: Name of the corresponding binaries of requested alloy. They should match the names in database. All implemented materials name list can be found in the README. The default is ['AlN', 'GaN'].

alloy.description: The alloy name. The name should match the name in database. All implemented materials name list can be found in the README. Case sensitive. The default is 'AlGaN'.

function.name: calculate_sheet_mobility
function.description: This function calculates the sheet mobility from different scattering contributions. The mobility models are implemented based on the following references.  Ref-1: J. Bassaler, J. Mehta, I. Abid, L. Konczewicz, S. Juillaguet, S. Contreras, S. Rennesson, S. Tamariz, M. Nemoz, F. Semond, J. Pernot, F. Medjdoub, Y. Cordier, P. Ferrandis, Al-Rich AlGaN Channel High Electron Mobility Transistors on Silicon: A Relevant Approach for High Temperature Stability of Electron Mobility. Adv. Electron. Mater. 2024, 2400069. https://doi.org/10.1002/aelm.202400069  Ref-2: Zhang, J., Hao, Y., Zhang, J. et al. The mobility of two-dimensional electron gas in AlGaN/GaN heterostructures with varied Al content. Sci. China Ser. F-Inf. Sci. 51, 780–789 (2008). https://doi.org/10.1007/s11432-008-0056-7  Ref-3: Mondal et. al., Interplay of carrier density and mobility in Al-rich (Al,Ga)N-channel HEMTs: Impact on high-power device performance potential. APL Electronic Devices 1, 026117 (2025) https://doi.org/10.1063/5.0277051  The considered scattering mechanism are: Interface roughness mediated (IRF) Threading dislocation mediated (DIS) Alloy disorder limited (AD) Deformation potential mediated (DP) Piezoelectric effect (PE) Acoustic phonon (AP) Polar optical phonon (POP)  Units: c_lattice => in nm a_lattice => in nm sc_potential => in eV n_2d => in nm^-2 rms_roughness => nm corr_len => nm n_dis => nm^-2 f_dis => unit less E_pop => eV

n_2d.type: 1D float array or float, optional (unit: nm^-2)
n_2d.description: Array containing carrier density data for compositions. This can be a single number as well. Then all compositions will have same carrier density. The default is 0.1.

rms_roughness.description: Interface root-mean-squared roughness for interface-roughness scattering contribution. The default is 0.1.

corr_len.description: Correlation length of interface roughness. The default is 1.

n_dis.description: Threading dislocation density. The default is 1.

f_dis.description: Fraction of dislocation that contributes in scattering. The default is 0.1.

T.description: Temperature at which mobility calculations will be done. The default is 300K.

alloy_disordered_effect.description: Whether to calculate alloy disordered mediated mobility. Or, whether to include this contribution in total mobility calculation. The default is False.

interface_roughness_effect.description: Whether to calculate interface roughness effect mediated mobility. Or, whether to include this contribution in total mobility calculation. The default is False.

dislocation_effect.description: Whether to calculate interface roughness effect mediated mobility. Or, whether to include this contribution in total mobility calculation. The default is False.

deformation_potential_effect.description: Whether to calculate deformation potential effect mediated mobility. Or, whether to include this contribution in total mobility calculation. The default is False.

piezoelectric_effect.description: Whether to calculate piezoelectric effect mediated mobility. Or, whether to include this contribution in total mobility calculation. The default is False.

acoustic_phonon_effect.description: Whether to calculate acoustic phonon effect mediated mobility. Or, whether to include this contribution in total mobility calculation. The default is False.

polar_optical_phonon_effect.description: Whether to calculate polar optical phonon effect mediated mobility. Or, whether to include this contribution in total mobility calculation. The default is False.

total_mobility.description: Whether to calculate total mobility. The default is True.

calculate_total_mobility_only.description: Calculate only the total mobility. If False the return data also contains individual specified contributions.

return_sc_rates.description: Return the scattering rates values.The default is False.

mobility_model.description: Which mobility model to use. The default is 'Bassaler'. The mobility is implemented based on following publications: 'Bassaler': J. Bassaler, J. Mehta, I. Abid, L. Konczewicz, S. Juillaguet, S. Contreras, S. Rennesson, S. Tamariz, M. Nemoz, F. Semond, J. Pernot, F. Medjdoub, Y. Cordier, P. Ferrandis, Al-Rich AlGaN Channel High Electron Mobility Transistors on Silicon: A Relevant Approach for High Temperature Stability of Electron Mobility. Adv. Electron. return.type: pandas dataframe with compositions and mobility (unit

function.name: calculate_sheet_resitance
function.description: This function calculates the sheet resistance.  Units: n_2d => in nm^-2 e => 1.602176634e-19 C mobility (mu) => cm^2 V^-1 s^-1  1 coulomb/volt = 1 second/ohm 1 ohm = 1 C^-1.V.s  R = 1/(e * n_2d * mu) ohm/square = 1/(1.602176634e-19*1e14 *n_2d * mu C.cm^-2.cm^2.V^-1.S^-1) = 62415.09074/(n_2d * mu) ohm/square

function.name: calculate_figure_of_merit
function.description: This function calculates the figure-of-merit (FOM). Available FOMs are LFOM: Lateral figure-of-merit  Ref: J. L. Hudgins, G. S. Simin, E. Santi and M. A. Khan, "An assessment of wide bandgap semiconductors for power devices," in IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics, vol. 18, no. 3, pp. 907-914, May 2003, doi: 10.1109/TPEL.2003.810840.  direct_bandgap_critical_electric_field = 1.73e5*(bandgap_**2.5) # V/cm indirect_bandgap_critical_electric_field = 2.38e5*(bandgap_**2.5) # V/cm  Units: bandgap_ => in eV. temp => in K n_2d => in nm^-2 E_cr => in V/cm e => 1.602176634e-19 C mobility (mu) => cm^2 V^-1 s^-1  LFOM = e*n_2d*mu*E_cr^2 = 1.602e-19 C * 1e14 cm^-2 * cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 * V^2cm^-2 = 1.602e-5 CVs^-1cm^-2 = 1.602e-5 Wcm^-2 #1 watts = 1 coulombs*volt/second = 1.602e-11 MW/cm^2
